title: Painting across the Home Plot and a bought West Field
about: Spring 2, 08:00, the West Field (x 5-8) bought beside the Home Plot (x 9-12): one 8-wide field of grass, y 16-25. Standing on the grass east of it at 13,20 facing west, hoe in hand. Hold Action and drag west far past the field: the row runs all 8 tiles, 12 to 5, and stops at the field's west edge, not at the border between the two plots (critic ruling C3-1: a painted path stays in the connected owned farmland of its first tile). Left hand: stand at 4,20 and draw east. QA item: "segurar o toque pra mexer automatico com multiplos tiles ta muito dificil de controlar".
